items.title: FDA approves PASCAL Precision system for transcatheter tricuspid edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) in severe TR
items.summary: On October 21, 2026, Edwards Lifesciences announced FDA approval of its PASCAL Precision system for tricuspid valve repair in patients with symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation despite optimal medical therapy who are at intermediate or greater surgical risk, and Edwards also announced a recent FDA approval of PASCAL Ace with Capture Clarity for degenerative mitral TEER.
bullets: **FDA approved the Edwards PASCAL Precision system** for **transcatheter edge-to-edge tricuspid repair (T-TEER)** (announced **21 Oct 2026**).
Indication: **symptomatic severe tricuspid regurgitation despite optimal medical therapy**, to improve **quality of life and functional status**.
Patients must be at **intermediate or greater surgical risk** and judged suitable by a **multidisciplinary heart team**.
Edwards says it is now the **only company** offering a **repair and replacement** portfolio for both **mitral and tricuspid** valves in the US.

Edwards also announced a recent approval of **PASCAL Ace with Capture Clarity** for **degenerative mitral TEER**, which it calls the **first FDA-approved TEER device with fluoroscopic indicators** confirming leaflet capture.
**One-year CLASP IITR** pivotal data are due as a late-breaker at **TCT**; the press release gives **no efficacy figures**.
Caveat: **company press release**; read the pivotal data and label before drawing conclusions.
